profile.name: MP-285三轴电动位移台
profile.description: MP-285 是一款三轴电动位移台/微操纵定位系统，可在 X、Y、Z 三个方向进行精密移动。它通常用于显微实验中对样品、探针或光学部件进行微米级定位与重复定位，并配有控制器进行速度、分辨率和运动模式设置。
profile.description_en: The MP-285 is a 3-axis motorized positioning stage/micromanipulation system that provides precise motion in X, Y, and Z. It is commonly used in microscopy-based laboratory setups to position samples, probes, or optical components with micron-scale control and repeatability, with a controller for setting speed, resolution, and motion mode.
